page.notes: Woodcut headpiece and historiated initial "I" (decorative E-like letter) are not text. Dagger marks (††) at the foot are reference marks. The word "runt" at the lower right is a printed catchword-like fragment and may be the end of "conciliaverunt". Some words in the column are doubtful, e.g. "Vuspinianum" for Vadianus' teacher Joachim Vadian's source name "Cuspinianum", and "Hericum"/"Henricum" readings; "Vnspimianum" transcribed as printed.
